transcript.text: How many active customers are there? Answer with the count.

args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers
FROM memory.bench.customers c
JOIN memory.bench.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

transcript.text:
Based on the working definition that an "active customer" is any customer with at least one order in the orders table, there are 80 distinct customers matching that criteria.

FINAL ANSWER: 80
